This large group was travelling fast out of PSB when we found them. We followed them N to ICW #57 and then turned the sighting over to Makila. Initially found 49LA + YOY with FB90, F122, FB25 + C, and a mom with a very bright white tip who had a very new (black with stripes) YOY. Also present were a smallish animal with a very falcate fin, and a clean mom + calf (larger) - (perhaps the same as seen with 49LA on Friday 23JUN95). By the time we began follow 10 min later, FB90, F122, FB25 + C had split off. By ~ 12:30 I realized there were only 6 animals: 49LA + YOY, white - tip + YOY, falcate, and one clean fin (may have been a member of M-C pair, maybe not). Group sized remained 6 animals until ~ 13:20, when a new pair joined - probably a mom + larger calf. By ~ 13:35, FB90, F122, FB25 + C had rejoined the group. These 12 animals (+ possibly 2 more) were in the area until ~ 14:20, although at times 49LA + C and 1 clean fin split off from the rest of the group. At ~ 14:20 the group stabilized at 10 animals: 49LA + YOY, white-tip + YOY, falcate fin, clean fin, FB90, F122, FB25 + C. These 10 animals comprised the group until ~ 15:42, although at times 49LA + C and clean fin broke off from the group. At ~ 15:45, others appeared (FB65 + C, hgih notch - no photos), and FB90, F122, FB25 + C split off. Until we left them at 16:15, the group consisted of 6 animals: 49LA + C, white-tip + C, falcate + clean fin.
